dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Hello! Ah, you look like you're from outside the village. Excuse me, but would you accept my request for an interview?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What? We've got reporters here too?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Hehe. A journalist, huh... Looks like I give people the same impression as a real one, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: That said, I'm not a real journalist. I'm studying hard to become one, though...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Just like the ones who write for The Steambird!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this next time, shall we...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Sure. Please be sure to accept my offer next time, though, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so there's a Melusine newspaper nowadays?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I—I'm working on one of my own. I record the things that happen every day into it — and I make some drawings for it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Huh. Wait a moment, I'm the one conducting the interview, so why are you the one asking the questions? Well, whatever — as long as the content's newsworthy...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Hmm... "Outland Visitor Reports Business to Merusea Chief Reporter! Guest Interested in the Future of Melusine News Industry!"

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's our title!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I didn't think that something this huge would happen in the village. Everything was quaking! Thank goodness no one was injured...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Well, a miraculous earthquake in which no one was injured sounds pretty cool, too!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Ah, I heard of your heroics during the earthquake. What would you say to an interview?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Eh? You mean you felt that rumbling in the earth, too?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: This is a first for our village! Hmm, my journalistic intuition tells me that some big scoop is about to come along.
